_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: pantry_items
constraints: CHECK (food_id IS NOT NULL OR barcode IS NOT NULL)

data.name: meal_items
constraints: CHECK (food_id IS NOT NULL OR barcode IS NOT NULL OR recipe_id IS NOT NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assumptions" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "title_es" TEXT NOT NULL, "explain_es" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_metrics" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "rhr_bpm" REAL NULL, "grip_kg" REAL NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_logs" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_effort" TEXT NULL CHECK("work_effort" IN ('OFF', 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH')), "heat_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("heat_minutes" >= 0), "ppe_full" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("ppe_full" IN (0, 1)), "screen_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "sober" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("sober" IN (0, 1)), "sleep_subjective" INTEGER NULL CHECK("sleep_subjective" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "intake_complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("intake_complete" IN (0, 1)), "sweat_feel" TEXT NULL CHECK("sweat_feel" IN ('poco', 'normal', 'mucho')), "effort_feel" INTEGER NULL CHECK("effort_feel" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "mood" INTEGER NULL CHECK("mood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "thermo_pre" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("thermo_pre" IN (0, 1)), "thermo_break" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("thermo_break" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "store" TEXT NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pantry_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "food_id" INTEGER NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "grams_remaining" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("grams_remaining" >= 0.0), "price_cents_per_kg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("price_cents_per_kg" >= 0), "purchased_on" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" TEXT NULL, "purchase_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), CHECK (food_id IS NOT NULL OR barcode IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products_cache" ("barcode" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("barcode"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name_es" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_template_items" ("template_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES meal_templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_id" INTEGER NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" INTEGER NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("grams" > 0.0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "block" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("block" IN ('BREAKFAST', 'MID_MORNING', 'LUNCH', 'AFTERNOON', 'DINNER', 'POST_WORKOUT')), "template_id" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_id" INTEGER NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" INTEGER NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("grams" > 0.0), "pantry_item_id" INTEGER NULL, CHECK (food_id IS NOT NULL OR barcode IS NOT NULL OR recipe_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cooked_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "food_id" INTEGER NULL, "recipe_id" INTEGER NULL, "grams" REAL NULL, "cooked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "heat_exposed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("heat_exposed" IN (0, 1)), "refrigerated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("refrigerated" IN (0, 1)), "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL CHECK("outcome" IN ('eaten', 'discarded')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_user_flags" ("food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_excluded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_excluded" IN (0, 1)), "user_trigger_reflux" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_trigger_reflux" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("food_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "template" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("template" IN ('A', 'B', 'BASELINE')), "readiness" TEXT NULL CHECK("readiness" IN ('VERDE', 'AMARILLO', 'ROJO')), "readiness_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("readiness_overridden" IN (0, 1)), "avg_hr" REAL NULL, "max_hr" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK("mode" IN ('normal', 'deload', 'retest')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "load_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valid_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tut_s" REAL NULL, "reached_failure" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("reached_failure" IN (0, 1)), "rest_pause_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "pose_reps" INTEGER NULL, "rep_timestamps" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_records" ("exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "load_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "e1rm" REAL NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "readiness" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "hrv_ln_rmssd" REAL NULL, "rhr" REAL NULL, "sleep_min" REAL NULL, "sleep_source" TEXT NULL, "band" TEXT NULL CHECK("band" IN ('VERDE', 'AMARILLO', 'ROJO')), "reasons" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "telemetry_samples" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start" TEXT NOT NULL, "end" TEXT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "start", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NOT NULL, "is_minimum" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_minimum" IN (0, 1)), "metric" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'check', "target" REAL NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_logs" ("habit_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("habit_id", "date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_state" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "current" INTEGER NOT NULL, "best" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repair_tokens" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attributes" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "attr" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("attr" IN ('FUERZA', 'RESISTENCIA', 'NUTRICION', 'RECUPERACION', 'DISCIPLINA')), "value" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date", "attr"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('estable', 'eventual')), "start_ts" TEXT NULL, "end_ts" TEXT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("minutes" >= 0), "rate_cents_per_hour" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rate_cents_per_hour" >= 0), "earned_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("earned_cents" >= 0), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('estable', 'eventual')), "rate_cents_per_hour" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rate_cents_per_hour" >= 0), "start_clock" TEXT NULL, "end_clock" TEXT NULL, "break_start" TEXT NULL, "break_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("break_minutes" >= 0), "days_mask" INTEGER NULL, "heat_exposure" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("heat_exposure" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'pausado', 'archivado')), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zones" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('chamba', 'entreno', 'descanso', 'otro')), "kind_label" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("latitude" BETWEEN -90.0 AND 90.0), "longitude" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("longitude" BETWEEN -180.0 AND 180.0), "radius_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("radius_m" >= 1), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'pausado', 'archivado')), "template_id" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "context_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone_id" INTEGER NULL, "transition" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("transition" IN ('entrar', 'salir')), "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('geocerca', 'manual')), "plan" TEXT NULL, "company" TEXT NULL, "feeling" INTEGER NULL CHECK("feeling" BETWEEN 1 AND 5));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mode_corrections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "inferred" TEXT NOT NULL, "corrected" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_mode" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "state_checkins" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("value" BETWEEN 1 AND 5));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_reminders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("trigger" IN ('llegar', 'salir')), "zone_kind" TEXT NULL CHECK("zone_kind" IN ('chamba', 'entreno', 'descanso', 'otro')), "zone_id" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'pausado', 'archivado')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "morning_alarms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "clock" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("days_mask" BETWEEN 1 AND 127), "snooze_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("snooze_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'pausado', 'archivado')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_cents" > 0), "planned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("planned" IN (0, 1)), "impulse" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("impulse" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'archivado')), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_cents" >= 0), "saved_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("saved_cents" >= 0), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'pausado', 'completado', 'descartado')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "actual_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("actual_cents" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_pauses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_cents" > 0), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "until_ts" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'esperando' CHECK("status" IN ('esperando', 'comprado', 'descartado')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "start_clock" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_min" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_min" > 0), "days_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("days_mask" BETWEEN 1 AND 127), "alarm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("alarm" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo' CHECK("status" IN ('activo', 'pausado', 'archivado')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_adjustments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("action" IN ('saltar', 'mover', 'extender', 'agregar')), "block_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES schedule_blocks (id), "start_clock" TEXT NULL, "end_clock" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "alarm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("alarm" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
